svg.aria-label: Apixly Media for VS Code: image generation, reference editing, video and recovery

svg.title: Apixly Media for VS Code
svg.desc: Create images, edit with references, generate video, and save finished assets into your project. Apixly Media is a free extension using the paid Apixly API.

g.text: Generate. Edit. Animate. Save to your project.
Free extension · Apixly API usage billed separately
